items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I knew his wife, Ruby, and I knew her mother

ctx.x: He lived here, and I knew Tatum. I knew his wife, Ruby, and I knew her mother, and I just got to be very close to them, you know. And this Mary that we're talking about, you know, she just idolized -- well, she idolized anybody that could play anything. God knows, I don't think there's another person in this world that loved musicians, and still does, more than she did at that time. Anybody.
